tiebreakers.description: Tied player who controls the Kingdom's Favour
Otherwise the tied player highest on the Order Track

notes: Base multiplayer. Enter Supply influence before final Lore conversion; do not double count. Lore only converts if no cards remain on Site of Power. Ties use Kingdom’s Favour, then highest Order Track position. Solo and second-printing/expansion changes are not automated.
